title: Classification / Odd One Out — In-Depth Guide — Part 2 of 16

questions.question: What does 'animal classification' test?
options: Whether a group of animals share a common category (species type, habitat, diet, etc.)
questions.rationale: Animal classification tests whether a group of animals shares a common biological or categorical property, identifying the one that doesn't belong.

questions.question: What does 'plant classification' test, similarly?
options: Whether a group of plants share a common category (type, use, growth pattern, etc.)
questions.rationale: Plant classification tests whether a group of plants shares a common categorical property, such as all being trees or all being flowering plants.

questions.question: What does 'food classification' test?
options: Whether a group of foods share a common category (fruit, vegetable, grain, etc.)
questions.rationale: Food classification tests whether a group of foods shares a common food category, identifying the one item from a different category.

questions.question: What does 'vehicle classification' test?
options: Whether a group of vehicles share a common category (mode of transport, fuel type, etc.)
questions.rationale: Vehicle classification tests whether a group of vehicles shares a common categorical property, such as all being land vehicles or all being powered the same way.

questions.question: What does 'tool classification' test?
options: Whether a group of tools share a common category or use
questions.rationale: Tool classification tests whether a group of tools shares a common category or characteristic use, identifying the one that doesn't fit.

questions.question: What does 'part-whole classification' test?
options: Whether a group of items are all parts of the same type of whole, with one being a part of something different
questions.rationale: Part-whole classification tests whether a group of components all belong to the same type of larger whole, finding the one that belongs to a different whole.

questions.question: What does 'material classification' test?
options: Whether a group of items are made of the same category of material (metal, wood, plastic, etc.)
questions.rationale: Material classification tests whether a group of items shares a common material category, identifying the one made of a different kind of material.

questions.question: What does 'number classification' broadly test?
options: Whether a group of numbers share a common numeric property (odd, prime, perfect square, etc.)
questions.rationale: Number classification tests whether a group of numbers shares a common numeric property, identifying the one number that breaks that shared pattern.

questions.question: In the set 3, 5, 7, 8, 11, which number is the odd one out based on 'Odd Numbers' classification?
questions.rationale: 3, 5, 7, and 11 are all odd numbers; 8 is even, breaking the shared odd-number property.

questions.question: What does 'Prime Number Classification' test?
options: Whether a group of numbers are all prime, with one number being composite (non-prime)
Whether numbers are all perfect squares
questions.rationale: Prime number classification tests whether a group of numbers are all prime, identifying the one number that is actually composite and breaks the pattern.
